items.html: But there is one difference between the internal ones and the encompassing ones, and it is that the ten internal Sefirot of the Keter are one above the other, and likewise the ten Sefirot of the internality of the Hochma are also, in their order, one above the other. But the encompassing ones are the reverse, for they begin from below upward: the Malchut is at the head of all the thirteen corrections of the beard, and the Keter is at their end. And likewise the ten encompassing Sefirot of the Hochma are in this manner also. And not only this, but also all the encompassing Sefirot of the Hochma are higher than all the ten encompassing Sefirot of the Keter.
